description:
You are an incident response analyst investigating potential port scanning activity. A colleague on the SOC team needs only the TCP SYN packets (initial connection attempts) from the capture file currently loaded in Wireshark (200722_tcp_anon.pcapng).

Your task:
1. Apply the display filter: tcp.flags.syn == 1 && tcp.flags.ack == 0
   This selects only SYN-only packets (connection initiation), excluding SYN-ACK responses.
2. Export ONLY the displayed (filtered) packets to a new capture file.
   Use File > Export Specified Packets, and make sure 'Displayed' is selected (not 'All packets').
3. Save the exported file as: /home/ga/Documents/captures/syn_packets.pcapng

The resulting file must contain only TCP SYN packets — no SYN-ACK, no data packets, no other traffic.
